preconditions.name: r1_sustained_threat_curriculum_fired
preconditions.description: SD-029 scheduled_external_hazard must fire on the axis-(b) measurement env (external_hazard_event_count > 0 in 3/3 seeds). Below -> env overlay mis-applied -> substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: axis-(b) overlay on a dim-matched scaffold p2 env (scheduled_external_hazard interval=20 prob=0.7 adjacent_only).

preconditions.name: r2_z_harm_a_nonzero
preconditions.description: z_harm_a NONZERO fraction must clear the floor on >= 2/3 seeds (the affective stream is populated; a flat-zero z_harm_a cannot cross). Below -> affective stream not engaged -> requeue.
preconditions.control: use_affective_harm_stream=True + scaffold_feed_harm_stream=True; axis-(b) hazard_harm=0.2 + proximity_harm_scale=0.2 lift the signal.

preconditions.name: r3_conversion_route_range_operative
preconditions.description: The 569i conversion is OPERATIVE here: the IN-ARM modulatory_channel_route_range (the V3-EXQ-662 RANGE statistic, read LIVE at the select tick) > floor on >= 2/3 seeds. SAME RANGE statistic 569i gates on. Below -> SD-056 under-trained / routing not wired -> requeue, NEVER a verdict.
preconditions.control: 569i-validated conversion config ON + SD-056 trained online on the axis-(b) env; positive control = e2_world_forward source with genuine per-candidate range.

preconditions.name: r4_committed_action_diversity_entropy
preconditions.description: The committed policy is NOT monostrategy-locked: selected-action class ENTROPY > floor on >= 2/3 seeds (the 569i C_R1B floor). This is the diversity that MUST reach committed action for z_harm_a to be ABLE to oscillate -- a monostrategy-locked policy makes 0 crossings for a CONVERSION reason, not an env-capability reason -> requeue. ENTROPY statistic, matching the diversity the C3 crossing criterion presupposes.
preconditions.control: scaffold-trained competent policy + 569i conversion config; positive control = 569i ARM_1 selected-action entropy strict-above controls.
